purpose: The one dated risk-free rate and equity risk premium of the lean valuation path (scripts/lean_model.py params rf and erp). Company research only. The heavy engine's dated inputs are a separate file (deep --market).

rf.title: US 10-year Treasury yield, 29-30.10.2026 market row
rf.evidence: research/companies/MSFT/2026-11-04/lean_params.json notes.rf_erp_beta ('rf 4.94% (10y UST, 29-30.10.2026 market row of the 1.11 draft)'); same value in the APH, GOOGL and NOW params of 04.11.2026
rf.retrieval: recorded from saved params; not re-read from a market feed when this file was written

erp.title: Damodaran implied ERP for the S&P 500 on 1 October 2026 (trailing 12 months, adjusted payout)
erp.evidence: docs/CHANGELOG.md (dated market inputs, 20.10.2026: Damodaran's implied ERP 4.20%); used by every saved lean params file

convention: rf is the 10-year US Treasury yield; erp is Damodaran's implied ERP for the S&P 500; the index return of the lean path is rf + erp.
Terminal growth = rf: the implied ERP is solved with perpetual growth at the Treasury yield, so the two are used as a pair (docs/CHANGELOG.md 0.13.0).
update_rule: One rf and one erp per valuation date: a lean params file dated D takes both from the entry in force on D (the latest entry whose `from` is on or before D).
Entries are append-only. A new reading of the 10-year yield or a new monthly implied ERP is added as a new entry with its own `from`, source and as_of; an existing entry is never edited.

A saved valuation is not rerun because a new entry appeared (stable-valuation rule): it takes the entry in force at its next update, and that update states in one line what the change of rf or erp moved.
A params file that uses another value states the reason in judgement.market.reason_if_different (fundamental_engine/locked_rules.validate_judgement).
How far the 10-year yield may move before a new entry is added is not set: that is the owner's decision. No entry has been added since 04.11.2026.
known_deviations: Saved lean params dated 05.11-13.11.2026 use rf 0.049 (the same reading rounded to one decimal; no saved note cites a separate source for it) next to 0.0494 in others, including on the same day (13.11.2026). Those files are not changed; the list is in the locked-rules audit of 15.11.2026.
